items: Before comparing QSR software, decide which part of your operation needs help, because ordering, guest experience, kitchen and inventory each call for a different tool.
Voice AI can take drive-thru and phone orders in parallel and confirm items, so your team can focus on getting the food right.
In the kitchen, AI can sequence tickets and track prep times to catch bottlenecks, while forecasting matches ordering and prep to what actually sells.
Momos handles guest experience: Alfie answers every review in your brand voice within minutes, and Rockie surfaces trends and ranks locations so headquarters knows where to focus.
